name: row_solvable_mono
lines: hview : rowViewOfSage hS π₁ x = rowViewOfSage hS π₂ x
hmulti : rowMultiset hS (fun v => Fin.castLE hnm (p v)) π₁ = rowMultiset hS (fun v => Fin.castLE hnm (p v)) π₂
⊢ rowMultiset hS p π₁ = rowMultiset hS p π₂
rowMultiset hS (fun v => Fin.castLE hnm (p v)) π = Multiset.map (Fin.castLE hnm) (rowMultiset hS p π)
⊢ rowMultiset hS (fun v => Fin.castLE hnm (p v)) π = Multiset.map (Fin.castLE hnm) (rowMultiset hS p π)
⊢ Multiset.map (fun i => Fin.castLE hnm (p (rowView hS π i))) Finset.univ.val =
Multiset.map (Fin.castLE hnm) (Multiset.map (fun i => p (rowView hS π i)) Finset.univ.val)
Multiset.map (Fin.castLE hnm ∘ fun i => p (rowView hS π i)) Finset.univ.val
⊢ Multiset.map (Fin.castLE hnm) (rowMultiset hS p π₁) = Multiset.map (Fin.castLE hnm) (rowMultiset hS p π₂)

steps.tactic: refine ⟨fun v => Fin.castLE hnm (p v), fun x π₁ π₂ hview hmulti => ?_⟩
apply hp x π₁ π₂ hview

have hmap (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin S)) :
  rowMultiset hS (fun v => Fin.castLE hnm (p v)) π = Multiset.map (Fin.castLE hnm) (rowMultiset hS p π) :=
  by
  dsimp [rowMultiset]
  rw [Multiset.map_map]
  rfl
